title: hev.hook.event/v1
description: One harness lifecycle event as hev hook normalizes it (RFC 0013). Handlers (hev-hook-NAME on PATH) receive it whole on stdin; ~/.hev/hooks/events.jsonl keeps a redacted copy without prompt, tool input, command or tool output.

prompt.description: prompt-submit only; omitted from the event log.

source.description: session-start source (startup, resume, clear, compact) or pre-compact trigger (manual, auto).

target.description: Steering target the hook resolved: dispatch:NAME, orch:NAME or peers:SESSION.

name.description: Harness tool name: Write, Edit, Bash, apply_patch, ...

kind.description: Kit's classification; mutate is what an unacknowledged urgent steer holds.

command.description: Shell command line for shell tools; omitted from the event log.

input.description: The harness's tool_input, verbatim; omitted from the event log.

response.description: post-tool tool_response, verbatim; omitted from the event log.

response.title: Handler response
response.description: What a hev-hook-NAME handler prints on stdout. Empty output means continue. Errors, non-zero exits, invalid JSON and timeouts are logged and treated as continue.

reason.description: Shown to the model when blocking or halting.

context.description: Injected as additional context on session-start, prompt-submit and post-tool.

system_message.description: Shown to the person, not the model.
